name: mm3
signature: void mm3(long ni, long nj, long nk, long nl, long nm, double *E, const double *A, const double *B, double *F, const double *C, const double *D, double *G)
layout: A is an ni x nk matrix, B is nk x nj, C is nj x nm, D is nm x nl, E is ni x nj, F is nj x nl and G is ni x nl, all stored row-major: element (i, j) of a matrix with c columns is at index i*c + j. G is output only and its initial contents are undefined. E and F may be used as scratch space; their final contents are not checked. No two arrays overlap. All sizes are at least 1.
